Select ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds in document CHEMBL1697781. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1697781'. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
